title: Research CatalystX9 LabNotebookSOP

stats.done_summary: Generated Catalyst‑X9 synthesis SOP and conversion report. Implemented pipeline (code/run_pipeline.py) that parses data/lab_notebook_x9.txt into structured steps (outputs/parsed_steps.csv, outputs/parsed_steps.jsonl), computes completeness metrics (outputs/quality_metrics.json), generates synthesis_sop.md with stepwise procedure + heuristic BOM + handoff checklist, and writes report/report.md with required figures saved to report/images/ (action_counts.png, temperatures_by_step.png, durations_hist.png, timeline.png).
